definitions: A particular order in which related things follow each other.
A set of related things that happen or are arranged in a particular order.
A part of a film, play, or piece of music that deals with one particular event or subject.
A succession of musical phrases or motifs, each at a higher or lower pitch than the last.
An ordered list of numbers or other elements.
The order of nucleotides in a DNA or RNA molecule, or of amino acids in a protein molecule.
examples: The dream sequence in the film.
